creature_families: Skeleton class (example model 26, giant or large skeleton) - shares the humanoid idle clip
Flying small creature (Dragonfly-type) - has a fly action slot and a per-creature scale correction
Humanoid NPC (guards, merchants) - one body with ten skin slots

top_creatures.label: Bone-guard giant
top_creatures.why: Tall skeleton whose authored mesh needed a percentage scale to read at the right height
top_creatures.keep: Tall silhouette; one shared humanoid idle clip
top_creatures.change: Our own silhouette (ribbed chest, different head); slower breathing idle to mark it as big

top_creatures.label: Dragonfly-type flier
top_creatures.why: Authored mesh about 1694 units across; needed Scale 10 to avoid filling the screen
top_creatures.keep: Separate fly action slot; scale field as a per-creature correction
top_creatures.change: Our own wings and flight loop; a size band that fits the 375-wide fight frame

top_creatures.label: Multi-skin humanoid NPC
top_creatures.why: One body mesh with ten skin slots so the face never takes the torso texture
top_creatures.keep: Slot-by-slot skin binding; the face as its own slot
top_creatures.change: Fewer slots, helm-first rig; a readable face at 375 wide

classes: Armsman (Albion): melee tank line; auto-trains Slash and Thrust; trainable Crush, Polearm, Shields, Two Handed, Parry, Crossbows; ref crates/caer-protocol/src/class_catalog.rs lines 289-318
Mauler (one name, three realms): hybrid; separate career key set per realm; ref crates/caer-protocol/src/career.rs lines 725-760
Necromancer and Bonedancer (pet classes): pet rules recorded as UNKNOWN in code; ref crates/caer-world/src/cfx/pets.rs lines 4 and 16
Realms: Albion 22 rows, Midgard 19, Hibernia 21 (62 total); ref crates/caer-protocol/src/career.rs lines 14-16 and CLASS_CAREERS

Stat curve: 1 point per stat point up to +10, 2 from +11 to +15, 3 beyond; budget exactly 30; ref crates/caer-protocol/src/starting_stats.rs lines 14-15 and 35; crates/caer-protocol/src/charcreate.rs line 694
gear_tiers: Armour tier is the extension byte on torso, arms, legs and feet; tier 0 read as 1; each tier is a numbered mesh part (BodyN, ArmsN, LegsN, BootsN); ref crates/caer-render/src/entities.rs lines 2755-2760
Figure and monster meshes carry no internal texture, only a material colour; ref crates/caer-assets/src/monsters.rs line 19
No metallic, gold or crystal shading in the static model shader crates/caer-render/src/mesh.wgsl (grep found no specular or rim term; skinned.wgsl not read)

looks.label: Translucent water surface
looks.technique: Flat alpha 0.62 surface drawn last with a lighting floor of 0.15; depth write is ON in the pipeline (the shader header says OFF, which is stale)

looks.label: Soft additive effect sprite
looks.technique: Camera-facing quad, premultiplied soft blob, additive blend; placeholder texture, not game art

looks.label: Two-sided diffuse shade
looks.technique: Absolute value of normal dot light, times texture, plus ambient and dynamic light from atmosphere tables

looks.label: Sky gradient per time of day
looks.technique: Two colours per time of day: zenith and horizon fog (fog doubles as horizon)

looks.label: Glow effect id on items (decoded, not drawn)
looks.technique: Per-item effect id parsed from EquipmentUpdate; stored on the world item; no renderer read

looks.label: Split spell sounds
looks.technique: Cast bed on the cast packet, land hit on the effect packet; land suppressed on failure or no-sound

looks.label: Region ambience scheduler
looks.technique: Region shapes, HHMM time window, weather gate, fixed or ranged spacing one-shots; ranged spacing is a counter in code, not random

looks.label: Corpse stays, living draw skips
looks.technique: is_dead flag decides the living draw; corpses drawn from a separate id list

originals.name: Slot-tier armour
originals.idea: A per-slot tier byte picks which numbered mesh variant shows; tier 0 reads as base
originals.change: Our own tier rows in data; a crest only on the top tier

originals.name: Visual scale row
originals.idea: Every creature has a percentage scale (100 = as authored) fixed in data, not code
originals.keep: The percentage field and its default of 100
originals.change: A QA check that fails any creature wider than the 375-wide fight frame

originals.name: Region ambience scheduler
originals.idea: Each region has a shape, a time window, a weather gate and a spacing for one-shots
originals.keep: Shape plus window plus weather plus spacing
originals.change: Seeded random interval per sound (donor counter is not random); our own sound names; cross-fade at borders

originals.name: Palette dungeon
originals.idea: A dungeon is a palette of pieces plus placement rows; empty rows means an empty zone and fails a check
originals.change: Ring arenas with our own pieces; hit radius per placement

originals.name: Rising stat-point cost
originals.idea: Stat points cost more as they stack (1 up to +10, 2 to +15, 3 beyond) and the budget must be spent exactly
originals.keep: Marginal cost rising at two thresholds; exact-spend rule
originals.change: Our own thresholds and budget for hero creation; live cost readout on the stat bar

originals.name: Water pool drawn last
originals.idea: A translucent flat surface drawn after everything else, one blend layer, depth write on
originals.keep: Drawn last; one layer; depth write on (code is right, header is wrong)
originals.change: Darker rim, ripple from the hit point, six-second fade for a blood pool

originals.name: Corpse stays, living draw skips
originals.idea: A dead entity stays as a corpse; the living draw skips it on a flag, not on zero health
originals.keep: The flag as the single switch
originals.change: Our own fade; a ghost pose later

originals.name: Glow slot on items
originals.idea: An item record carries an effect id a glow shader reads
originals.change: Our own rim-and-pulse glow for rare tiers only, shown in the phone inspect view
